name: Sign In with Native Provider
summary: Resolves a validated native-provider assertion to an existing durable identity through an existing link or an explicitly confirmed link, then establishes an authenticated session.

completionPredicate.expression: durable-identity == resolved and pending-identity-status == resolved and session-capability == authenticated-normal

coverageAssessment.rationale: Existing-link and explicit-link paths are represented together with email-mismatch preservation, but provider denial, invalid assertion, and missing-provider-subject outcomes are not yet atomic scenarios.
